limits: Generated history matches user-scale volume; private transcript contents were not sent to providers.
Product and extra screenshot review is implementer self-review, not independent review. Runtime verifier uses a separate context and the same model lineage.

Three-file repair/18 immutable tests ran on the frozen source candidate with signed RC18 helper; signed RC19 runs used their own bundled helper and retained the same accepted data, adding real model recovery, long receipt and large terminal-write measurements.

Source full-task result-return round trips peaked around 470–485ms and wheel paint at 283ms; signed follow-up max input/wheel round trips 114/72ms, main-loop max 285ms. No claim of zero latency spikes or long-term acceptance.
Six minor standard product layout/capture limits retained; initial source task screenshot is explicitly limited.

Unmodified signed Mac bundle ran from an isolated temporary location. Daily application and user data were not replaced; no Squirrel installer handoff, Windows/Linux interactive installation, full screen reader or arbitrary-project acceptance.
All copied credentials removed and owned test applications exited.
Rollback requires a full pre-upgrade backup because old versions may reject new journal events.
